scope: Read-only documentary check of provided Gowin manual excerpts; no hardware, no Gowin compilation, no bitstream parsing.

claims.claim: SUG100 documents Print BSRAM Initial Value for GW5A(S)(T)-138/GW5AT-75, with default or partial BSRAM print modes under the stated MSPI jump or Multi Boot quad condition.
claims.limitation: This is a bitstream-generation option in the normal flow; it does not establish a standalone post-route patcher for an already generated bitstream.

claims.claim: SUG100 documents Generate Post-Place File as a Place & Route option that creates a .posp file containing only BSRAM placement information; default is False.
claims.limitation: .posp contains only BSRAM placement information and is not by itself a bitstream update; it requires the option to be enabled before Place & Route.

claims.claim: SUG1220 documents the exact Tcl syntax set_option -gen_posp 1 for generating a .posp Place & Route output containing only BSRAM placement information; default is 0.
claims.limitation: This is a Place & Route generation option, not a bitstream merge or patch command, and produces no bitstream by itself.

claims.claim: SUG1220 documents set_option -bit_incl_bsram_init 1 to print BSRAM initial values into the bitstream; for GW5A-family devices it covers BSRAMs in the same column as occupied BSRAM.
claims.limitation: Documented as part of Place & Route bitstream generation, not as standalone patching of already routed output.

claims.claim: SUG1220 restricts -bsram_init_print_mode, with default or partial mode, to GW5A(S)(T)-138/GW5AT-75; partial mode requires multiboot_mode or mspijump_mode set to quad.
claims.limitation: Device and mode restrictions mean generic GW5A assumptions do not transfer to all variants; verify exact device, package, and configuration.

claims.claim: IPUG913 identifies the physical merge tool at ...\tool\merge_bit\bin\merge_bit.exe for Gowin_PicoRV32.
claims.limitation: The tool path is documented for Gowin_PicoRV32 only; it does not imply support for AE350 or GW5AST-138.

claims.claim: IPUG913 documents the exact command parameter: merge_bit.exe bin-file fs-file itcm_size posp-file.
claims.limitation: The positional itcm_size is given in KB; applying it to GW5AST-138 or AE350 ITCM sizes is not documented in the examined excerpt.

claims.claim: IPUG913 requires Post-Place File generation by setting Place & Route > General > Generate Post-Place File to True in order to provide the posp-file used by merge_bit.
claims.limitation: If an existing routed project lacks .posp, the documented merge path first requires Place & Route to be rerun with this option.

claims.claim: IPUG913 describes a repeated software-update flow for Gowin_PicoRV32 using BUILD_MODE BUILD_LOAD, sections.lds, and merge_bit against a fixed hardware bitstream and posp file.
claims.limitation: Synthesis and Place & Route are still required for the first hardware design; subsequent software-only updates avoid rerunning them only within this Gowin_PicoRV32 flow.

claims.claim: IPUG913 lists supported devices for the Gowin_PicoRV32 merge method as LittleBee, Arora, and Arora V families only.
claims.limitation: GW5AST-138 and AE350 are not in the documented supported list in the examined excerpt; absence in examined scope is not proof of impossibility elsewhere.

claims.claim: MUG1031 documents Gowin RiscV_AE350_SOC ITCM as an optional instruction memory with configurable size and initialization path; SPI Flash instruction memory is enabled by default.
claims.limitation: The excerpt documents configuration during SoC/IP setup; it does not document merge_bit, .posp, or post-route bitstream updating for AE350 boot code.

claims.claim: MUG1031 states ITCM initialization files are hexadecimal files itcm0 through itcm3 produced under .../example/Emb_TCM/tool/make_hex, with sizes from 32KB to 512KB.
claims.limitation: This describes initial-image creation for regeneration; no post-route update shortcut was found in the examined pages.

claims.claim: No .posp, merge_bit, or bitstream-patch procedure for AE350 ITCM or boot code appears in the examined MUG1031 and IPUG913 pages.
claims.limitation: This is 'not found in examined scope' and not a universal impossibility claim; manuals may contain other sections outside the provided excerpts.
